pageDescription: Fixed targets, one active run at a time, and auditable recovery through the protected Fault Run API.
drainHookRegistered: Coordinator drain hook was registered before target cleanup.
noDrainHook: No Coordinator drain hook was recorded.
scenarioTarget: Start {label} against its fixed target. The server will validate the submitted parameters before activation.
catalogHashTarget: Create one Catalog-owned Redis Hash with the submitted field count and value size. The server will re-check SKU availability, budget, TTL, and the fixed target.
stopRunDescription: Stop {label}? The run will begin its recovery flow.
restartNotificationDescription: Check notification-service health and restart the fixed target only when it is unavailable.
cleanupDescription: Remove resources created by {label} run {id}. Only this run namespace is addressed; the default cache and business data are not targeted.
cleanupFailed: Failed to clean Fault Run resources
recoveryError: Recovery ended with a recorded error.
networkError: Unable to reach the control plane.
notificationUnavailableHelp: Only a confirmed restart of the fixed notification-service target is allowed.
activeRunControlHelp: An active run is already locking this control.
activeRunStopHelp: The active run can be stopped from the target row.
catalogValidationHelp: Parameters are validated by the scenario catalog.
catalogHashValidationHelp: One Hash, N SKU fields. The service performs the final budget and SKU validation.
notificationRestartHelp: Notification service is unavailable; restart the fixed target before starting another run.
byteValueHelp: Use B, K, KB, M, MB, G, or GB for byte values (case-insensitive). Each field is capped at 128M and the whole Hash at 512M: N × S must fit both limits. Read concurrency only controls pressure.

BROWSE_REPORT_SQL.label: Product browse slow SQL
BROWSE_REPORT_SQL.description: Run historical scans and query-plan comparisons on the product report path.

ORDER_REPORT_SQL.label: Order report slow SQL
ORDER_REPORT_SQL.description: Run the customer order report range and detail aggregation path.

BROWSE_SURGE.label: Browse traffic surge
BROWSE_SURGE.description: Sustain controlled concurrency against the real product API through Gateway.

ORDER_QUERY_SURGE.label: Order query surge
ORDER_QUERY_SURGE.description: Sustain compliant demo-customer traffic against the order query path.

CATALOG_REDIS_LARGE_VALUE.label: Product detail Redis Hash
CATALOG_REDIS_LARGE_VALUE.description: Create and read a bounded product-detail Hash through the real catalog API.

CART_CATALOG_DEPENDENCY.label: Cart dependency failure
CART_CATALOG_DEPENDENCY.description: Fail the real Cart-to-Catalog dependency before a cart write.

NOTIFICATION_HEAP_PRESSURE.label: JVM memory leak
NOTIFICATION_HEAP_PRESSURE.description: Retain high-cardinality objects until the notification JVM runs out of heap.

NOTIFICATION_STORAGE_APPEND.label: Notification storage growth
NOTIFICATION_STORAGE_APPEND.description: Grow persistent storage with run-scoped notification transaction data.

PROMOTION_LOCK_CONTENTION.label: Promotion deadlock
PROMOTION_LOCK_CONTENTION.description: Trigger a real database deadlock through competing promotion reservations.

INVENTORY_TABLE_EXCLUSIVE.label: Inventory table lock
INVENTORY_TABLE_EXCLUSIVE.description: Hold an exclusive database table lock that blocks inventory reads.

INVENTORY_ROW_LOCK.label: Inventory row lock
INVENTORY_ROW_LOCK.description: Hold a row-level inventory reservation while the normal reservation summary path waits.

PSP_PROVIDER_OUTCOME.label: PSP external dependency
PSP_PROVIDER_OUTCOME.description: Inject an external PSP dependency outcome into the payment path.

durationSec.label: Run duration
durationSec.description: 1-3600 seconds; the scenario limit is shown above.

concurrency.label: Concurrency
concurrency.description: 1 or more concurrent requests; no upper limit.

pageSize.label: Page size
pageSize.description: 1-100 records returned per request; larger pages increase response work, not concurrency.

minFreeBytes.label: Minimum free space
minFreeBytes.description: 1B-1GB free-space floor for the target volume.

memberCount.label: Hash fields (N)
memberCount.description: 1-47 SKU fields; one additional sellable SKU stays as the probe.

memberSizeBytes.label: Value size (S)
memberSizeBytes.description: 256B-128M per field; N × S must stay at or below 512M.

keyTtlSec.label: Safety TTL
keyTtlSec.description: 1-3600 seconds; must be at least run duration + 60 seconds.
